name: MangaMeeya
summary: Long the best-known manga reader on Windows: opens ZIP/RAR comics, also nested archives, with spreads, thumbnails, tabs and customisable keys. Discontinued with no official download; copies and the compact MangaMeeyaCE circulate on mirrors.
where_it_wins: Familiar manga workflow for long-time users
Tabs and split windows over two monitors
where_schnellbild_wins: Photos and videos, not only comics
